source_pack.reason: The screenshots contain personal names, messages, avatars and app/content branding. Only anonymized derived skeletons are committed.

screens.notes: Top chrome is split into three independent surfaces; bottom input is inset and raised above the system edge.
The same top composition persists over a reading surface; the scroll affordance is transient and detached.
Counterexample to a universal island model: the header remains more monolithic while filters, FAB and navigation are separate layers.
A page app bar is composed from role-owned clusters rather than one full-width background.
Chrome floats over an immersive content canvas; navigation icons are not necessarily enclosed by a dock surface.
A persistent mini-player dock is stacked above a separate destination navigation model.

taxonomy.warning: Pill/capsule describes geometry, not semantic component identity. Chip is valid only for compact selection/filter/suggestion controls.

design_system_implications: Share a surface primitive only where material and state requirements match; do not merge compositions by rounded geometry.
Model top-leading, center-context and top-trailing ownership independently in page archetypes.
Treat safe-area anchoring, keyboard avoidance, scroll compaction and content occlusion as runtime/layout contracts.
Keep destinations in one navigation model even when the dock is detached from the screen edge.
Test contrast over photo, poster, plain and scrolling underlays before accepting blur/translucency/elevation.
